question: Should Vaccinium myrtillus be recommended for: relief of discomfort and heaviness in the legs related to minor venous circulatory disturbances?

records.notes: EU herbal monograph on fresh bilberry (Vaccinium myrtillus) fruit grants traditional-use status only for relief of leg heaviness and minor venous circulatory discomfort and skin capillary fragility, based on long-standing use rather than clinical trial evidence.
records.source_title: Community herbal monograph on Vaccinium myrtillus L., fructus recens
records.target_indication: relief of discomfort and heaviness in the legs related to minor venous circulatory disturbances
records.primary_outcome: relief of discomfort and heaviness in the legs related to minor venous circulatory disturbances
